pages.title: Admin Commands
pages.text: All commands require permission level 2 and the right item in your hand.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob flee add|remove|list$() - hold a spawn egg to add/remove that mob from the never-flee list.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob exclude add|remove|list$() - hold a spawn egg to make that mob completely unaffected by this mod; some mobs with unusual breeding are excluded by default.

pages.title: Diet Commands
pages.text: $(bold)/pasturetales item food add [value]|remove|list$() - hold any item to make it animal food; without a value, its own nutrition is used.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob diet$() - hold a $(bold)spawn egg$() to see that mob's diet.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob diet add herbivore|carnivore|omnivore$() - set its diet.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob diet remove herbivore|carnivore$() - remove it from a diet list (back to omnivore).$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob diet list$() - print the herbivore and carnivore lists.

pages.title: Eggs, Bait & Troughs
pages.text: $(bold)/pasturetales mob oviparous add$() - hold that mob's spawn egg in your $(bold)main hand$() and the egg it lays in your $(bold)off hand$() to register it as oviparous; it no longer gets pregnant and instead lays eggs on a cycle like a chicken.$(br2)$(bold)/pasturetales mob oviparous remove|list$() - hold the spawn egg to remove it, or print the current list.$(br2)Bait: $(bold)/pasturetales item bait allow add|remove|list$() edits the whitelist (works even if inedible), $(bold)/pasturetales item bait ban add|remove|list$() edits the blacklist (no fish even in water); the blacklist wins if an item is on both.$(br2)Troughs: $(bold)/pasturetales item trough ban add|remove|list$() - hold an item to forbid/allow it in feeding troughs.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.text: Open the config screen from the Mods menu, or edit $(bold)pasturetales-common.toml$() in the config folder.$(br2)See $(l:animalflee:commands/config_overview)Common Settings$() for what you can change.$(br2)Most options apply immediately. Two exceptions: whether an animal is born fearless is decided once per animal, and the trough search range only takes effect after re-entering the world.
